name: Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition

raw.os: Windows Vista - Service Pack 1 / Windows XP - Service Pack 3
raw.processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 1.8GHz, AMD Athlon X2 64 2.4GHz
